You may be confused: we introduced the double variable type to tackle problems we can't solve with just String and int variable types, yet the problem we faced (currency) was one in which limited double precision is actually problematic! Are there any problems in which the double variable type is sufficient?

In general, the double variable type is useful for representing continuous numeric values when having thorough precision is not necessary. For example, imagine we want to compute the perimeter and area of a rectangle.
